description_fill_in: Anonymised unique patient identifier, P0001 to P5000. P0001-P0500 are the original records; P0501-P5000 are AI-generated synthetic records.
Body Mass Index in kg/m2 (range 18.0-39.8), stored with 1 decimal place.
Blood pressure reading in mmHg (range 60-140). One value per patient; the source does not say whether it is systolic or diastolic, and the unit is inferred from the value range.
Blood glucose level in mg/dL (range 70-200). Unit inferred from the value range; fasting or random is not specified.
Total cholesterol in mg/dL (range 150-280). Unit inferred from the value range.

Target variable: 1 = disease present, 0 = no disease. One combined binary label (the project brief names diabetes, heart disease and hypertension; the file does not say which). Exactly 50% / 50% across the full 5,000 rows.
